paper_title: Bounds on heavy axions with an X-ray free electron laser
notes: Light-shining-through-wall (Primakoff conversion in Ge crystals) experiment at European XFEL. Data from Table I: 5 discrete detuning angles. The on-Bragg run (delta-theta=0) covers a broad mass range ma <~ 44 eV (paper quotes sensitivity down to ~1e-3 eV), encoded here as a flat two-point segment [1e-3, 44] eV at g=3.91e-4 GeV^-1. The four off-Bragg runs are narrow-band (width ~1e-3 eV) limits at ma = 340, 460, 1100, 2400 eV; each is represented by a single point. 90% CL upper bounds from zero observed events (Ndet=2.3). Laboratory bound, no DM density assumption.
